meta.note: Sampled page views, bots and prerenders excluded (personal AI agents count only where a rule asks for them). `weeks[]` are 7-day windows from `start`; the last one is partial when `weeks > fullWeeks`. `growth` is the last full week over the first, null without two full weeks of 10+ bundles each. `today.vsAll` compares a rule with all views (1 = the same; `didNothing` below 1 is better). `standsOut` marks a small rule (under 5% of views) that is clearly more engaged or growing 2x or more: call it out by name. `today.supportRate` is the rule's secondary action (`support`) on the homepage. `secondOrder` (with --site) is site-wide: `first[]` = pages people open right after the homepage (share of those arrivals), each with `next[]` = what they click on there; `assists.pages[]` = pages viewed right before the conversion, `lift` against the site rate. Rules with `modelled: true` depend on on-device memory, which Optel cannot see: they are estimated at steady state from what views do today. Rules with `firstVisitAssumed: true` ask for a first visit, which Optel cannot see either: every view counts as one, so their share is an upper bound. `topClicks[].link: false` is a click that opened something on the page (menu, search, carousel) rather than a link: its `click` is the element selector.
